text:
(a) Minimum water flow
Acetone in gas in: 100 x 0.020 = 2.00 kmol/h.
Acetone absorbed (95%): 0.95 x 2.00 = 1.90 kmol/h.
Gas out acetone mole fraction: 0.05 x 0.020 = 0.0010.
At minimum flow the liquid out is in equilibrium with gas in:
x_out = 0.020 / 1.8 = 0.01111.
Balance: L_min x 0.01111 = 1.90, so L_min = 1.90 / 0.01111 = 171 kmol/h.

(b) Absorption factor
Operating water flow L = 1.5 x 171 = 256.5 kmol/h.
A = L / (m G) = 256.5 / (1.8 x 100) = 256.5 / 180 = 1.425.

(c) Number of theoretical stages
Kremser equation, with x_in = 0 for pure water:
N = ln[ (y_in / y_out)(1 - 1/A) + 1/A ] / ln A
N = ln[ (0.020 / 0.0010)(1 - 1/1.425) + 1/1.425 ] / ln 1.425
N = ln[ 20 x 0.2982 + 0.7018 ] / 0.3542 = ln(6.667) / 0.3542
N = 1.897 / 0.3542 = 5.36.

FINAL (a): 171 kmol/h
FINAL (b): 1.425 dimensionless
FINAL (c): 5.36 stages
